defs.def: the organ in the body where food is digested 胃；肚子

ex.s: Microplastics have become a common source of pollution across the Earth — they have settled in the deep sea and on the Himalayas, stuck inside volcanic rocks, filled the stomachs of seabirds and even fallen in fresh Antarctic snow.
ex.t: 微塑料已成为全球普遍的污染源——它们沉积在深海和喜马拉雅山上，卡在火山岩中，填满海鸟的胃，甚至落在南极的新鲜积雪里。

ex.s: In the skeleton, a person lies on his or her stomach on the sled, with his or her head pointing downhill!
ex.t: 在骨架上,一个人躺在雪橇上的肚子上,头朝下指向山坡!

ex.s: As a result, they burned more fat during walks on an empty stomach than when they had eaten first.
ex.t: 结果，他们空腹走路时燃烧的脂肪多于先吃饭时。

ex.s: On the first day of my first grade，I stood by the door with butterflies in my stomach.
ex.t: 一年级开学第一天，我站在门口，心里像有蝴蝶扑腾般紧张不安。

ex.s: So far there is no effective way to get rid of it, but a new study suggests an answer may lie in the stomachs of some hungry worms.
ex.t: 到目前为止，还没有有效的方法来摆脱它，但一项新研究表明答案可能在于某些饥饿蠕虫的胃里。

ex.s: 14 hours later the films had lost 13% of their mass — apparently broken down by enzymes (酶) from the worms’ stomachs.
ex.t: 14小时后，薄膜失去了13%的质量——显然是被蠕虫胃中的酶（酶）分解了。

ex.s: “When your child says, ‘My stomach hurts,’ you can say, ‘Well you had a lot of sugary foods and you might feel better if you made some other choices,’” says Markey.
ex.t: “当孩子说‘我肚子疼’时，你可以说：‘你吃了很多含糖食物，如果换些别的选择，可能会感觉好些，’”Markey说。

ex.s: The cats in consequence turned their attention ‒ and their stomachs ‒ back to the native birds, killing up to 60,000 each year.
ex.t: 因此，猫把它们的注意力——以及它们的胃口——转回到了本地鸟类身上，每年捕杀多达60000只。

ex.s: When the Japanese cut open his body, they discovered only tree bark, cotton and grass roots, but not a single grain of rice in his stomach.
ex.t: 当日本人剖开他的身体时，发现里面只有树皮、棉花和草根，胃里连一粒米都没有。

ex.s: On the day of the concert, I was so nervous that I woke up with butterflies in my stomach.
ex.t: 音乐会那天，我紧张得醒来时心里七上八下的。

ex.s: A good way of saying “I am full” is moving your hand in circles over your stomach after a meal.
ex.t: 说“我饱了”的好方法就是在一顿饭之后,把你的手圈在你的胃上。

ex.s: I began a second drawer for more general discoveries: new cave system discovered with dozens of nameless species, four hundred species of bacteria found in the human stomach.
ex.t: 我开始了第二个抽屉，用来放更一般的发现：被发现的有几十种无名物种的新洞穴系统、在人体胃部发现的四百种细菌。

defs.def: to not want to eat sth 不想吃 … ；对 … 没有胃口

ex.s: His judgment and references are decidedly American, as well as his delicate stomach.
ex.t: 他的判断和参考明显是美国式的他那脆弱的胃也是如此。

ex.s: For those who can stomach it, working out before breakfast may be more beneficial for health than eating first, according to a study of meal timing and physical activity.
ex.t: 根据一项关于进餐时间与身体活动的研究，对那些能承受的人来说，早餐前锻炼可能比先吃饭更有益健康。

defs.def: to not have the desire or courage to do sth 没有做某事的欲望（或勇气）
to approve of sth and be able to enjoy it; to enjoy being with a person 欣赏；欣然接受；喜欢和 … 相处
to be able to eat sth without feeling ill/sick 能吃；吃得下
